title: Aggregated control switches the Perps trade list between one row per order and every fill
description: Proves the Aggregated pill on Activity > Perps > Trades collapses each order's fills into one row when checked and lists every execution when unchecked. Data prerequisite: the slot fixture account (Trading, 0x316B...01fa) on Hyperliquid testnet, whose trade history contains orders that filled in several pieces.

setup-restart.intent: Start from a freshly launched app so the trade history loads from scratch

setup-status.intent: Confirm the mobile bridge is reachable

setup-unlock.intent: Reach a signed-in wallet so Perps history is readable

setup-nav-perps-root.intent: Open the full trade history screen

gate-perps-trades.intent: Make sure the trade history really is filtered to Perps trades before reading it

ac1-wait-control.intent: See the Aggregated control offered alongside the Perps and Trades filters

ac2-press-control.intent: Turn the Aggregated control off the way a user inspecting their executions would

ac2-screenshot-individual.intent: Show the same trade list breaking those orders into their individual executions
ac2-screenshot-individual.label: AC2: Aggregated off - one row per fill

setup-open-type-filter.intent: Open the activity type picker the way a user narrowing to Perps does

setup-wait-type-sheet.intent: See the type picker open before choosing Perps

setup-choose-perps.intent: Narrow the activity list to Perps

ac1-run-transform-tests.intent: Establish that one order's fills are summed when aggregation is on and listed separately when off
ac1-run-transform-tests.cmd:
yarn jest app/components/UI/Perps/utils/transactionTransforms.test.ts -t "aggregation" --no-coverage > temp/tat-3932/artifacts/transform-tests.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -20 temp/tat-3932/artifacts/transform-tests.log
grep -q "Tests:.*passed" temp/tat-3932/artifacts/transform-tests.log || exit 1
exit $status

ac1-assert-transform-tests.intent: Fail the proof when the on/off fill grouping rules are not met

ac1-index-test-log.intent: Keep the fill grouping test output as reviewable evidence

ac2-wait-rows.intent: See the trade rows finish loading before reading them

ac2-screenshot-aggregated.intent: Show the trade list with each order's fills combined into one row
ac2-screenshot-aggregated.label: AC2: Aggregated on - one row per order

ac2-wait-after-toggle.intent: See the list settle on the individual executions after the control is turned off
